"OBS → Media Source
Disable Local File · Format: mpegts
%1$s

Latency is in ms in this app and microseconds in OBS. Match both ends. Try OBS Network Buffering at 0 MB. Lower latency can cause dropouts. Total delay includes camera, network and OBS.

Automatic reconnection stays enabled while publishing. STOP cancels retries. Leaving the app stops streaming. Keep the OBS source active and try a 1 s reconnect delay in OBS. Bitrate adapts to congestion without changing resolution. For stability, try 120–200 ms at both ends.

Stop streaming to change settings. Each phone needs a different port."
